items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Any of your brothers in the band? ... Aaron. Yeah.

ctx.x: I gave you all the names. Want to take us?

Uh, we can get those later. Eh? We can get those later if you... Who? We can get the names of the band later. I don't really need all of them. Uh, was, were you, any of your brothers in the band? Were I what? Any of your brothers in the band? My brothers? Aaron. Yeah. Any of your brothers in the band? He's hard of hearing.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: Yeah. Aaron. Maybe I can help him.
